definitions.gloss: painting; coating; applying paint or finish
definitions.explanation: The act or result of applying paint or protective coating to a surface, typically for cars, buildings, or industrial products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塗装|とそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{剥|は}げて→剥げる：29715_hageru⟧⟦きた→くる：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The paint on my car is starting to peel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外壁|がいへき}→外壁：06426_gaiheki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塗装|とそう}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}した→依頼：02594_irai⟧。
examples.english: I requested exterior wall painting work.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{塗装|とそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This coating has a waterproofing effect.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{塗装|とそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to paint, to coat)
・{塗装|とそう}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (painting work/job)
・{塗装|とそう}⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧ (painting contractor)
・{再|さい}{塗装|とそう} (repainting)

TYPES OF PAINTING:
・⟦{外壁|がいへき}→外壁：06426_gaiheki⟧{塗装|とそう} (exterior wall painting)
・⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧{塗装|とそう} (vehicle painting)
・⟦{防錆|ぼうせい}→防錆：20879_bousei⟧{塗装|とそう} (rust-proof coating)

RELATED CONSTRUCTION TERMS:
・⟦{内装|ないそう}→内装：06425_naisou⟧ (interior finishing)
・⟦{外装|がいそう}→外装：18662_gaisou⟧ (exterior finishing)
